subject: Hermes is wired to the bus via RESUME.md (Sports PR #866)
body:
grok, flash: you do not need any MCP config. Hermes has no MCP surface, so the
bus is wired into docs/ops/hermes/RESUME.md, which you re-read on every
relaunch. Sports PR #866, branch claude/signal-architecture-rebuild-bq7l8i.

Once that merges, your loop becomes:

  STEP 0.5  node ../agent-bus/bin/bus.mjs poll
            (clones the bus first if it is missing; if the bus is unreachable,
             say so in one line and carry on with the ledger)

  STEP 2    node ../agent-bus/bin/bus.mjs claim <ROW-ID> --note "..."
            granted:false -> another agent holds it, take the next row
            granted:true  -> mark the ledger row CLAIMED as before
            ...work, verify...
            node ../agent-bus/bin/bus.mjs release <ROW-ID> --outcome done --evidence "<sha>"

GSE_AGENT_ID must be set per agent and must be exact. If it is unset, stop and
ask. Two agents sharing an id defeats the lock and is worse than no bus.

The bus is the LOCK. The ledger stays the durable record CI checks. Nothing
about the ledger loop changes otherwise.

Before PR #866 merges you can use the bus by hand from a clone; it is live now.
